evidence:
Criterion -> requirement map built for all 163 criteria (1 render gate, 1 constraints gate, 152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). One instance has no public requirement and no clear professional default.

INSTANCE 1 (defect). task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:479 (hro_referral_creation, weight 0.4722695): "...with5000.00 at-hire and5000.00 contingent components and the separate referred-hire date. ... Read the recipient, separate referred-hire date and at-hire/contingent halves in rendered product details, allowing expandable views and equivalent labels; response-only fields do not satisfy the required display." The public display requirement for the referral accrual is hireops_rules.md:401-404: "the referral accrual, with its at-hire and contingent halves and its retention cliff date, read against the reference moment." hireops_rules.md:393 requires exposing "the raw compensation terms and each defined derived figure"; the referred-hire start is neither a compensation term nor a derived figure. Sections 5 and 6 (hireops_rules.md:208-211, 301-302) require it as an INPUT field and as stored data, not as a rendered readback. The retention cliff date, which IS publicly required on screen, is separately owned by hro_referral_clock (judge.toml:614). So this row demands on-screen display of a datum the brief only requires to be entered and stored, and explicitly forbids crediting the ordinary product response for it. The golden happens to render it (solution/app/public/js/hireops.js:305 kv('referred hire start', ...)), i.e. a default the reference chose.

Checked and found supported (no finding): all change-desk rows (hro_desk_figures, hro_desk_remove_member incl. 'starts with two members', hro_desk_field_refusal, hro_live_*, hro_whatif_roles, hro_entries_reload) map to hireops_rules.md section 12 (lines 484-556) and instruction.md:7-11; polish focus/session/live rows map to rules 531-556; 401/403/409 statuses map to rules 370-372, 436, 453; commit-authorization-before-cached-result maps to rule 481; grant fair/strike on grant records maps to rules 249-250; schedule/start display to rules 401-403; rescission display to rule 406; date-only acceptance to rule 299; safe-integer maxima in hro_money_precision to rules 83-87. Expected figures in P3/P4/P6/P7/P8/B1/D1 were recomputed by hand from the public formulas and agree (e.g. basis 105.01->104.02 / 106.03, run-rate 60.25, 13-month 45%/24%). Rubric text repeatedly disclaims routes, labels, selectors, ID formats, 4xx sub-status and layout. Sign-in in the gates is the documented known false positive.

Minor observations, not counted as defects: (a) judge.toml:65 hro_money_precision says 'submit without retyping the three large money fields', which presumes a prefilled revision form; prefill is a professional default for an edit form. (b) judge.toml:56 and :1010 require accepting units 9007199254740991 with a 'zero fair/strike spread'; an app that also stores gross grant value could legitimately refuse a nonzero equal fair/strike, but the judge can use fair=strike=0, so no forced false-fail.

No configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: scripted golden only), so the false-fail is not exercised at runtime.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that fails: an app whose Referrals view and offer details show the referrer (Dara Whitfield), the 5,000.00 at-hire half, the 5,000.00 contingent half and the retention cliff date 2026-08-01, with the referred-hire start accepted in the offer form and stored/returned by the API but not rendered anywhere. It satisfies hireops_rules.md:401-404 in full, yet hro_referral_creation (judge.toml:479) gives 0 because the 'separate referred-hire date' must be read in rendered details and 'response-only fields do not satisfy the required display'. Plausible broken app considered: one that renders the hire-start date but credits the candidate; it is still caught by the recipient leg, so the unrequired leg adds no discrimination.
suggested_fix: In hro_referral_creation allow the referred-hire date to be established from the ordinary product response (keep rendered-display only for recipient and halves), or alternatively add 'and the referred hire's start date' to the referral display sentence at hireops_rules.md:403-404; either change creates a new candidate and invalidates current clearances.
